info.name: candleserv API
info.description:
Consumer-facing REST API for **candleserv** — a self-contained multi-source 1m BTC OHLCV composite candle store.

## Base URL

Set the `baseUrl` collection/environment variable. Defaults to `http://localhost:3007` (the service's default `PORT`).

## Authentication

Every `/v1/*` route requires a nonce-signed token in the `Authorization` header (no `Bearer` prefix — the header value **is** the token). `/health` is unauthenticated.

The token is built per request as:

```
token = base64( apiKey + ":" + nonce + ":" + chop )
chop  = SHA256( apiSecret + ":" + nonce ).hex.slice(0, 19)
```

- `nonce` must **strictly increase** for a given key — the server rejects any nonce `<=` the last one it saw (`401 Nonce replay rejected`). This collection's pre-request script uses `Date.now()` and persists the last value in the `lastNonce` variable to guarantee monotonicity, so parallel sends in the same millisecond don't collide.
- The pre-request script runs at the **collection level** and only attaches the header to requests whose path starts with `/v1`.

Set `apiKey` and `apiSecret` as environment variables (template provided alongside this collection). **Never commit the secret.**

## Composite candle shape

Every candle object returned by the `/v1/candles*` endpoints:

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `timestamp` | number | Bar-open time, unix **milliseconds** |
| `open` / `high` / `low` / `close` | number | Composite OHLC, real-USD space |
| `volume` | number | **Normalized** volume (`raw × baseline/sourceCount`) |
| `sourceCount` | number | Venues that contributed this bar |
| `sourceCountBaseline` | number | 24h mode of `sourceCount` |
| `sources` | number | Bitmask of contributing venues (see below) |
| `confidence` | number | `[0,1]` — `sourceRatio × (1 − rejectedRatio)` |

**Source bitmask** (`sources` is the OR of these): binance=1, bybit=2, kraken=4, coinbase=8, bitfinex=16, okx=32, gate=64, bitget=128.

## Timeframes

`1m, 5m, 10m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 2h, 4h, 6h, 12h, 1d, 3d, 7d, 30d`. Higher timeframes are aggregated from 1m on the fly; `30d` is a calendar-month rollup. (`/v1/premium` supports all of these **except** `30d`.)

request.description:
Unauthenticated liveness + freshness probe.

Returns:
- `status` — `"ok"`
- `uptime` — process uptime, seconds
- `latestCandle` — timestamp of the newest composite candle (or null)
- `gapsPending` — count of gaps in `detected`/`healing` state
- `activeSubscriptions` — open SSE streams
- `collectionLatency` — `{ avgMs, minMs, maxMs, sampleSize }` over the last 60 bars
- `recentOutages` — up to 5 recent venue outage events

item.name: Candles (v1)

query.description: Required. Timeframe: 1m,5m,10m,15m,30m,1h,2h,4h,6h,12h,1d,3d,7d,30d.
Optional. Number of candles to return, oldest-first. Default 1, max 5000.
Optional. Asset code. Default BTC (pre-multi-currency consumers may omit it).

request.description:
The most recent `n` candles for a timeframe, ending at now (oldest-first). Redis-cached with a boundary-aware TTL.

Returns `{ "candles": [ ...candle ] }`.

query.description: Required. Timeframe (see /latest).
Required. ISO-8601 instant; returns the `limit` candles ending at/just before this time.
Optional. Default 100, max 5000.
Optional. Default BTC.

Optional. When `true`, long-poll: hold the response until a 1m candle closing at/after `endingAt` is ingested, then return. `endingAt` must align to the tf boundary. Supported tfs: 1m,5m,15m,30m,1h,4h,6h,1d,7d. 504 on timeout, 503 if a repair job is running.
Optional. Only with waitForFresh. Default 15000, max 60000.

request.description:
A window of `limit` candles ending at `endingAt` (oldest-first).

Returns `{ "candles": [ ...candle ] }`.

**waitForFresh long-poll:** enable the `waitForFresh`/`maxWaitMs` params to block until the bar closing at `endingAt` exists — used by downstream cron consumers that need the just-closed bar without polling. Returns 504 (`candle not available within maxWaitMs`, includes `lastAvailableTs`) on timeout, 503 (`repair in progress`) if a recompose/repair job is in flight.

Batched multi-timeframe read in a single auth/nonce pair. All-or-nothing: any invalid or failing entry fails the whole batch with the offending index.

Body: `{ "requests": [ { "tf", "endingAt", "limit", "currency?" }, ... ] }`
- Max 16 entries, each `limit` capped at 5000, `limit` must be a positive integer.
- `waitForFresh` is intentionally not supported here.

Returns `{ "results": [ { "tf", "currency", "endingAt", "candles" }, ... ] }` in input order.

Note: this POST is semantically a read — it is allowed on read-only replicas and is blocked (503) during repair jobs.
Whether the calling API key currently has an active SSE stream open, plus its parameters. Useful before opening a `/v1/candles/stream`.

query.description: Optional. Rolling buffer size pushed on each event. Default 1, clamped 1..200.
Optional. Default BTC — an event for another currency never wakes this stream.

request.description:
Server-Sent Events stream — **1m only**. On connect, immediately pushes the last `n` candles; thereafter pushes the rolling last `n` whenever a new 1m composite for `currency` is ingested.

Event name: `candles`. Data: `{ "candles": [ ...candle ], "count": <n> }`.

Use Postman's *Send* on this request to open the stream (Postman renders SSE events live). The stream is dropped briefly at the start of a repair job and should be reconnected by the client.

item.description: Composite OHLCV reads. All routes require nonce-auth (attached automatically by the collection pre-request script).

item.name: Premium (v1)

query.description: Optional. Default BTC.
Optional. Timeframe, default 1m. All standard tfs except 30d.
Optional. ISO-8601 instant the window ends at. Default now.
Optional. Bars per venue. Default 200, capped at 5000 and by a ~93-day raw-minute budget (so tf=1d reaches ~90 days; tf=1m is bar-capped to ~3.5 days/call).
Optional. Restrict to one venue: binance,bybit,kraken,coinbase,bitfinex,okx,gate,bitget. Omit for all venues.

request.description:
Per-venue **cross-exchange premium-offset** history — the signed-USD leave-one-out basis that the composite engine computes internally and discards, re-derived from the archived per-source candles + paired stable rates.

For each venue and minute, the offset is `peg_adjusted − median(peers' peg_adjusted)` (USD-native venues pass through un-pegged). Per-minute offsets are aggregated to **OHLC-of-offset** bars per timeframe:
- `o` / `c` — open/close-field offset at the bucket's first/last minute
- `h` / `l` — widest / narrowest the basis got anywhere in the bucket (the intraday excursion closes hide); the wick always encloses the body
- `n` — contributing minutes

Offsets exist only for minutes with ≥3 accepted venues (mirrors the engine). **Bitfinex** is the headline slice (USD-native → its entire basis lands in the offset, a tether/venue-stress observable).

Returns `{ "currency", "tf", "unit": "usd", "venues": { "<venue>": [ { t, o, h, l, c, n }, ... ] } }` (bars ascending, `t` = bucket-open unix ms).

query.description: Optional. Default BTC.

request.description:
Which venues have derivable premium history for a currency, whether each is peg-corrected (USDT) or USD-native, and the coverage window of its archived source data.

Returns `{ "currency", "venues": [ { "name", "usdNative", "hasData", "oldest", "newest", "count" } ] }` (`oldest`/`newest` are unix ms or null).

item.description: Per-venue premium-offset (cross-exchange basis) history. See research/methods #12 and chit/articles/01_bitfinex_premium. Nonce-auth, attached automatically.

item.name: Peg (v1)

request.description:
Immediate per-venue **USDT→USD peg** at the last closed minute (`MAX(timestamp)` in `stable_rates_1m_sources`).

USDT-only over the four peg venues (`binance`, `bybit`, `gate`, `bitget`); there is no USDC (never priced) and no kraken/coinbase/bitfinex/okx (USD-native, store no peg). A venue with no row at that minute is omitted (fail-visible), never stale-filled.

Returns `{ "unit": "usd", "USDT": { "<venue>": <rate>, ... }, "timestamp": <unix ms|null> }`.

query.description: Optional. Timeframe, default 1h. All standard tfs except 30d.
Optional. ISO-8601 instant the window ends at. Default now.
Optional. Bars per venue. Default 200, max 5000. Trimmed per-venue.
Optional. Restrict to one peg venue: binance,bybit,gate,bitget. Omit for all.

request.description:
Per-venue **OHLC-of-rate** history for the USDT→USD peg (the intraday high/low drift is the signal; the consumer averages downstream). No `currency` param (the peg table is currency-agnostic). Rejected rows filtered out.

Each bar: `t` bucket-open unix ms, `o`/`h`/`l`/`c` OHLC of the per-minute rate, `n` contributing minutes.

Returns `{ "unit": "usd", "tf", "USDT": { "<venue>": [ { t, o, h, l, c, n }, ... ] } }` (bars ascending). History depth is bounded by source retention (~180 days today), not a fixed window.

The four peg venues, each with its `pegSourcePair` provenance and archived-rate coverage window.

`pegSourcePair` is the ticker each venue's rate derives from (`binance`/`bitget` `USDCUSDT`, `gate` `USDC_USDT`, `bybit` direct `USDTUSD`). `oldest`/`newest` are unix ms.

Returns `{ "venues": [ { name, pegSourcePair, hasData, oldest, newest, count }, ... ] }`.

item.description: Per-venue USDT→USD stablecoin peg (read-only, over stable_rates_1m_sources). USDT-only, four venues (binance/bybit/gate/bitget); no USDC, no USD-native venues. Nonce-auth, attached automatically.

exec: // Attach the candleserv nonce-signed Authorization header to /v1/* requests.
console.warn('candleserv: set apiKey and apiSecret variables (environment or collection).');
// Nonce must strictly increase per key; persist the last one used.
